# [mods] Tires, wheels and fitment

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Choose LT255/85R16 size tires, expecting to buy five including the spare. [t431]

[Partial] Select the LT265/75R16 size for a 32.1-inch diameter with approximately half an inch taller than typical LT sizes. [t431]

[Partial] Select LT265/75R16 tires for a 32.8-inch diameter, noting the specific cut is 32.1 inches. [t431]

[Partial] Expect wheels to look smaller after adding lift and larger tires while watching for vibration. [t559]

Check if the EVAP canister is directly behind the left rear wheel. [t623]

[Partial] Consider pre-runner style fenders or cheap rubber extensions from JC Whitney for a finished look. [t623]

[Partial] Choose between 1-inch or 2-inch spacers to achieve a total stance width of 2-4 inches. [t214]

[Partial] Calculate wheel offset and select an 18x9 inch wheel with a -10mm or zero offset. [t428]

[Partial] Mount new tires on the larger diameter wheel with a bolt pattern of 6x114.3 and lug threads of 12mm by 1.25. [t428]

[Partial] Compare the new wheel's inside edge depth to stock measurements of a 16x7 wheel with an approximate 30mm offset. [t428]

[Partial] Select a Toyo Open Country A/T II tire with Xtreme sizing and an overall height of approximately 32.6 inches. [t428]

[Partial] Verify the new aftermarket wheel weight of approximately 40 to 60 lbs against stock specifications. [t428]

Install new TPMS sensors on the larger diameter wheel. [t428]

[Partial] Test fit the wheel to ensure caliper clearance with a 10mm offset. [t428]

Select a Toyo tire with Xtreme construction weighing approximately 58 lbs. [t428]

[Partial] Compare the new tire's overall height to stock dimensions. [t428]

[Partial] Verify the total weight increase of the wheel and tire combo. [t428]

[Partial] Determine bolt pattern diameter, measure axle hole spacing, identify wheel width, use sizing charts, and check backspacing. [t746]

[Partial] Select a 16-inch rim diameter to accommodate the 285/75R16 tire. [t746]

[Partial] Look for a newer lug pattern of six lugs with a 5-inch spacing. [t746]

[Partial] Stock steel rim and tire weights compared to Nissan S Alloy wheel and three different Goodyear or BFG tire totals. [t740]

Expect a fuel mileage drop of 2-3 MPG when switching from stock to larger tires. [t744]

[Partial] Observe that larger tires rotate less at highway speeds, resulting in slightly lower RPMs. [t744]

## Tips & gotchas

- This tire offers approximately the same width as a 265/75R16 but is lighter than its wider counterparts. [t431]
- Expect to buy five of these tires (including a spare) for matching sets. [t431]
- This tire is approximately half an inch taller than typical LT sizes, offering extra ground clearance over obstacles. [t431]
- [Partial] Note that the sidewall construction features three plies for added durability and aggression. [t431]
- This tire offers approximately the same width as a standard 265 but is lighter than its wider counterparts. [t431]
- Note that this specific cut measures at 32.1 inches in diameter. [t431]
- Expect wheels to look smaller after adding lift and larger tires. [t559]
- Watch for vibration between 27-32 MPH, which may require shimming. [t559]
- [Partial] Check if the EVAP canister is directly behind the left rear wheel to ensure enough space after trimming. [t623]
- [Partial] Consider pre-runner style fenders or cheap rubber extensions from JC Whitney for a finished look. [t623]
- Focus on the bottom inside corner of the wheel well, about 5 inches from the outer edge. [t214]
- This modification is necessary regardless of whether you have a body lift or suspension lift configuration. [t214]
- Hub/wheel-centric designs place the wheel/tire weight on lips rather than relying solely on lugs. [t214]
- Lug/lug centric spacers put all pressure directly on the stock Xterra lugs. [t214]
- Use online sizing charts to predict fitment. [t746]
- Check backspacing values when selecting a wider wheel. [t746]
